 Mr. T. J. Mendon, for the Appellants.
 Ms. Suvarna Yadav, for the Respondent No.1.
 Mr. Himanshu Jha, i/b Poonam Mital, for the Respondent No.2.
 Coram: R. M. Joshi, J.
 Dated: 7th March, 2026.
 Pc:-
1.

Learned counsel for the Appellants/Original Claimants submits that the Tribunal committed an error in dismissing the claim petition on the ground that the Claimants had received benefits under the Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Act, 1948, and Section 53 thereof creates a bar to claiming compensation under the said Act simultaneously with a claim under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 ('M.V. Act').
It is his submission that such a bar would apply only in cases where the employer and the tortfeasor is the same person, as contemplated by Section 53 of the ESI Act and Section 167 of the M.V. Act.
In order to support his submissions, he places reliance on the judgment of the Division Bench of this Court in the case of Inspector General of Police v. Sayed Adam1.

75-FA-836-2023.DOC places reliance on other case laws in order to support his submission that just like any other insurance benefit, an employee receives benefit under the ESI Act provided he contributes to the same.

It is his submission that in such circumstances, the Tribunal has committed error in rejecting the claim petition solely on the ground that the Claimants had received benefits Balu Pandurang Raut And Ors. vs Halima Arif Meman And Anr. on 7 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35786571/
